title: Code in Place assignments with AI style feedback
summary: Students submit Python programs in a large introductory course and receive automated feedback on code style. An AI feedback system evaluates qualities that ordinary correctness tests do not capture, giving students timely comments intended to help them revise toward readable, elegant code.

sources.title: AI Teaches the Art of Elegant Coding: Timely, Fair, and Helpful Style Feedback in a Global Course

assessment.summary: Submit Python code and use automated style comments to improve its readability and elegance.
student_actions: Review AI-generated style feedback and revise code.

student_role.description: Students receive and may act on AI-generated style feedback.

assessment_system_role: Evaluate submitted code style and generate comments.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
